title: Exact maps between fixed associated sheaves of a graded chain
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $S=k[T_0,T_1]$. Let $M,A_0,A_1,A_2$ be internally integer-graded $S$-modules with degree-compatible scalar multiplication. Suppose degree-preserving maps form an exact chain $0\to A_2\to A_1\to A_0\to M\to0$. Fix module sheaves $F,E_0,E_1,E_2$ on $\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj], each equipped with injective additive standard-open chart maps onto degree-zero fractions, respecting ring actions and the homogeneous restriction formula [lem-weil-pbc-proj-graded-module-sheaf-exists]. Then there exist maps $E_2\to E_1\to E_0\to F$ with monic first map, epic last map, and exactness at both middle terms. No projective-line isomorphism or transported arrows occur in this statement.

source.place: Definition 27.8.3 (01M6), construction preceding it; Lemma 27.8.4 (01M7), clauses (2),(3),(5) and final paragraph

proof.text: Put K=range(f_1), with degree-j part K intersect G_0(j). Decompose each preimage into finitely many homogeneous parts; degree preservation and internality show the degree-j projection of an image is itself an image. Thus these parts give an internal grading on K, compatible with scalar multiplication. The injectivity, two range/kernel identities and surjectivity give the short exact sequences A_2 -> A_1 -> K and K -> A_0 -> M.

Use the underlying additive-subgroup polynomial grading for gradedModuleSheaf_exists and tilde_functorial, and the canonical scheme isomorphism with the homogeneous-submodule Proj obtained by identifying homogeneous ideals and fraction charts. Its chart ring maps and restrictions agree. Construct the associated sheaf of K and canonical sheaves/stalk charts for the other modules. The given chart data identify each fixed sheaf with the canonical one: invert the injective map onto its stated range and compose with the canonical chart equivalence. The scalar equations make this linear over the chart ring. For any basic-open inclusion standardOpenProperties gives g^e=af; both chart restrictions agree on all fractions by the supplied restriction formulas. Apply exists_sheafOfModules_from_basis to these compatible chart isomorphisms. Transport the canonical stalk maps across the resulting sheaf isomorphisms.
Use tilde_functorial on the two triples to construct the induced maps with their fraction formulas. Use proj_sheafification_shortExact for the two short sequences and these formulas.

Compose E_1 -> K~ with K~ -> E_0. The first short exact sequence supplies a mono E_2 -> E_1, and the second an epi E_0 -> F. Composing with a mono leaves the first kernel unchanged, and composing with an epi leaves the second image unchanged. The two short exactness identities therefore establish exactness at E_1 and E_0.

theorem graded_chain_maps_exact (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (𝓜 : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (h𝓜 : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜)
    (hsmul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ℤ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (y : M),
      a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → y ∈ 𝓜 z → a • y ∈ 𝓜 (n + z))
    (F : (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Modules)
    (alpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ),
      0 < d → f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d →
      F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)) →+
        LocalizedModule.Away f M)
    (halpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d),
        Function.Injective (alpha f d hd hf) ∧
        Set.range (alpha f d hd hf) = degreeZeroFractions
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝓜 n : Set M)) (Submonoid.powers f))
    (hscalar : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (r : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (s : F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
        alpha f d hd hf (awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f r • s) =
          algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
            (Localization.Away f) r • alpha f d hd hf s)
    (hres : ∀ (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d b : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hb : 0 < b)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (hg : g ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k b)
        (inc : basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) g ≤
          basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (e c : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
        0 < e → a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k c → g ^ e = a * f →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : M)
          (s : F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
          alpha f d hd hf s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
          alpha g b hb hg (F.val.map (homOfLE inc).op s) =
            mk (a ^ m • y) (⟨g ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g))
    (A : Fin 3 → ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (𝒢 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ℤ → AddSubgroup (A i))
    (f₂ : A 2 →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] A 1)
    (f₁ : A 1 →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] A 0)
    (f₀ : A 0 →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] M)
    (h𝒢 : ∀ i : Fin 3, DirectSum.IsInternal (𝒢 i))
    (hA_smul : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (s : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (x : A i),
        s ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → x ∈ 𝒢 i j →
          s • x ∈ 𝒢 i ((n : ℤ) + j))
    (hf₂ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (x : A 2), x ∈ 𝒢 2 j → f₂ x ∈ 𝒢 1 j)
    (hf₁ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (x : A 1), x ∈ 𝒢 1 j → f₁ x ∈ 𝒢 0 j)
    (hf₀ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (x : A 0), x ∈ 𝒢 0 j → f₀ x ∈ 𝓜 j)
    (hinj : Function.Injective f₂) (hex₁ : LinearMap.range f₂ = LinearMap.ker f₁)
    (hex₀ : LinearMap.range f₁ = LinearMap.ker f₀) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f₀)
    (E : Fin 3 → (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Modules)
    (hE : (∀ i : Fin 3,
        ∃ (alpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ),
          0 < d → f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d →
          (E i).val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)) →+
            LocalizedModule.Away f (A i)),
          (∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
            (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d),
            Function.Injective (alpha f d hd hf) ∧
            Set.range (alpha f d hd hf) = degreeZeroFractions
              (fun n : ℕ ↦ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
              (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝒢 i n : Set (A i))) (Submonoid.powers f)) ∧
          (∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
            (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
            (r : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
            (s : (E i).val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
            alpha f d hd hf (awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f r • s) =
              algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
                (Localization.Away f) r • alpha f d hd hf s) ∧
          (∀ (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d b : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hb : 0 < b)
            (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
            (hg : g ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k b)
            (inc : basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) g ≤
              basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
            (e c : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
            0 < e → a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k c → g ^ e = a * f →
            ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : A i)
              (s : (E i).val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
              alpha f d hd hf s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
              alpha g b hb hg ((E i).val.map (homOfLE inc).op s) =
                mk (a ^ m • y) (⟨g ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g)))) :
    ∃ (g₂ : E 2 ⟶ E 1) (g₁ : E 1 ⟶ E 0) (g₀ : E 0 ⟶ F),
      Mono g₂ ∧ Epi g₀ ∧ (ComposableArrows.mk₃ g₂ g₁ g₀).Exact
